title: ExternalTeleportCommandWindow
description: This mod adds an external teleportation window to the game to support symbols that are not supported by the vanilla teleport command.
body:
This mod adds an external teleportation window to the game to support symbols that are not supported by the vanilla teleport command, such as "e"/"^", and it has been open-sourced on GitHub.

It also enables the game to recognize numbers from scientific notation. Like: _2^4,  5^3, 10^3._

You can open the external teleportation window by pressing the Y key to perform teleportation, which requires an OP level of 2.

**Please don't try to enter some numbers that may cause the game to crash! I'm not responsible for the crash caused by this situation!**

Note: Entering excessively large numbers may cause the game to crash, such as 2^31-1, 2e10, etc.
